    The subcategories C_J are extriangulated (Proposition 2.3, Corollary 2.4) #

    The induced structure on C_J consists of the restricted extension bifunctor and realizations, and the binary biproducts of C(D), which C_J contains. The axioms not involving biproducts pass from C(D) to C_J because C_J is full and closed under extensions: the new middle terms in the existence axiom and in (ET4), (ET4)ᵒᵖ lie in C_J. A biproduct chosen in C_J is only isomorphic to the one of C(D); for (ET2) we transport realizations of C(D) along isomorphisms of their end terms, which holds since every finite diagram lies in some C_{Iic m}, where realizations are the sequences going to distinguished triangles.
